title: Coaching
learning_outcomes: Explain coaching versus directing in the context of coaching.
Compare and distinguish questions and feedback in the context of coaching.
Apply development goals in the context of coaching.
Evaluate and justify decisions about boundaries in the context of coaching.

lessons.title: Coaching versus directing
lessons.outcome: Explain coaching versus directing in the context of coaching.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving coaching versus directing; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to coaching simulation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain coaching versus directing from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of coaching versus directing; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Questions and feedback
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish questions and feedback in the context of coaching.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving questions and feedback; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to coaching simulation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain questions and feedback from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of questions and feedback; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Development goals
lessons.outcome: Apply development goals in the context of coaching.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving development goals; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to coaching simulation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain development goals from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of development goals; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Boundaries
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about boundaries in the context of coaching.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving boundaries; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to coaching simulation.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain boundaries from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of boundaries; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of coaching versus directing; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of questions and feedback; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of development goals; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of boundaries; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Experienced leader, governance or organisational psychology reviewer.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
